reported_sources.text:
`borg_quaff_crit()`: "Avoid drinking CCW twice in a row" returns false
  (74 times in 100) when the last CCW was quaffed *more* than 4 game turns
  ago; the extra `borg_timer(..) > 0` test is implied by `> 4`.
